Forecast.title: Forecast
Forecast.description: One user's whole forecast: the same document the app keeps on the device and writes to backup files, plus a revision number that rises by one on every save.

userId.description: Firebase Auth user ID of the owner; equals the document ID

revision.description: Starts at 1 and rises by exactly 1 on every save

sources.description: Recurring income, expense, liability and savings items

records.description: Dated occurrences: one-time items and recurring ones the user acted on

updatedAt.description: Server time of the last save

/financialData/{userId}.description: One forecast document per user, readable and writable only by that user
